a: The Azure Region where the Managed Redis instance should exist. Refer to "Redis Cache" on the product availability documentation for supported locations. Changing this forces a new Managed Redis instance to be created.
The name which should be used for this Managed Redis instance. Changing this forces a new Managed Redis instance to be created.
The name of the Resource Group where the Managed Redis instance should exist. Changing this forces a new Managed Redis instance to be created.

The features and specification of the Managed Redis instance to deploy. Possible values are `Balanced_B0`, `Balanced_B1`, `Balanced_B10`, `Balanced_B100`, `Balanced_B1000`, `Balanced_B150`, `Balanced_B20`,…
Whether to enable high availability for the Managed Redis instance. Defaults to `true`. Changing this forces a new Managed Redis instance to be created.
The public network access setting for the Managed Redis instance. Possible values are `Enabled` and `Disabled`. Defaults to `Enabled`.
A mapping of tags which should be assigned to the Managed Redis instance.
The ID of the key vault key used for encryption. For example: `https://example-vault-name.vault.azure.net/keys/example-key-name/a1b2c3d4`.
The ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the Key Vault Key.
Whether access key authentication is enabled for the database. Defaults to `false`.
Specifies whether redis clients can connect using TLS-encrypted or plaintext redis protocols. Possible values are `Encrypted` and `Plaintext`. Defaults to `Encrypted`.
Clustering policy specified at create time. Possible values are `EnterpriseCluster`, `OSSCluster` and `NoCluster`. Defaults to `OSSCluster`.

Specifies the Redis eviction policy. Possible values are `AllKeysLFU`, `AllKeysLRU`, `AllKeysRandom`, `VolatileLRU`, `VolatileLFU`, `VolatileTTL`, `VolatileRandom` and `NoEviction`. Defaults to `VolatileLRU`.
The name of the geo-replication group. If provided, a geo-replication group will be created for this database with itself as the only member.
The frequency of Append Only File (AOF) backups. The only possible value is `1s`. Providing this value implies AOF persistence method is enabled.
The frequency of Redis Database (RDB) backups. Possible values are `1h`, `6h` and `12h`. Providing this value implies RDB persistence method is enabled.
The name which should be used for this Managed Redis instance. Changing this forces a new Managed Redis instance to be created.
Configuration options for the module (e.g. `ERROR_RATE 0.00 INITIAL_SIZE 400`).

Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Managed Redis instance. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both).
Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Managed Redis instance.
(Defaults to 45 minutes) Used when creating the Managed Redis instance.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the Managed Redis instance.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the Managed Redis instance.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when updating the Managed Redis instance.
The ID of the Managed Redis instance. Changing this forces a new Access Policy Assignment to be created.
The object ID of the Azure Active Directory user, group, service principal, or managed identity to assign the access policy to. Changing this forces a new Access Policy Assignment to be created.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when creating the Managed Redis Access Policy Assignment.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the Managed Redis Access Policy Assignment.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the Managed Redis Access Policy Assignment.
A set of other Managed Redis IDs to link together in the geo-replication group. The ID of this Managed Redis is always included by default and does not need to be provided here.
The ID of the Managed Redis through which geo-replication group will be managed. Linking is reciprocal, if A is linked to B, both A and B will have the same linking state.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when creating the Managed Redis Database Geo-Replication.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the Managed Redis Database Geo-Replication.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the Managed Redis Database Geo-Replication.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when updating the Managed Redis Database Geo-Replication.
